item.realmlord.acupuncture_needles.desc: Use on someone (or on yourself) to heal 3 hearts and clear harmful effects. A physician heals more.
item.realmlord.animal_salve.desc: Use on an animal: heals it fully and clears harmful effects.
item.realmlord.bamboo_feed.desc: Use on a panda: ready to breed, or a cub grows.
item.realmlord.beast_whistle.desc: Calls all your tamed animals within 128 blocks to you.
item.realmlord.cima_boat.desc: The red-sailed scout: the fastest thing on the water.
item.realmlord.clarity_pill.desc: Clears nausea, blindness, slowness, weakness, fatigue and hunger.
item.realmlord.diving_bell.desc: Right-click: three minutes of water breathing and sight under water.
item.realmlord.fishing_boat.desc: Two fishermen; fish caught from it come in a third more often.
item.realmlord.fishing_net.desc: Right-click on water to cast for fish.
item.realmlord.fodder.desc: Use on a farm animal: ready to breed, or a young one grows.
item.realmlord.green_tea.desc: Haste for three minutes; settles the stomach.
item.realmlord.guardian_charm.desc: Carried: saves one of your animals from death, once.
item.realmlord.horse_feed.desc: Use on a horse: heals it, quickens it and makes it trust you.
item.realmlord.horse_tonic.desc: Use on a horse: Speed II, Jump Boost II and regeneration for five minutes.
item.realmlord.immortal_wine.desc: Luck II and Strength for ten minutes.
item.realmlord.imperial_feast.desc: Fills you entirely, with Strength, Resistance, Haste and regeneration.
item.realmlord.jade_pendant.desc: In the off hand: +2 Luck and +2 health.
item.realmlord.lifebuoy.desc: In the off hand in water: breathe, and swim like a dolphin.
item.realmlord.luopan.desc: The geomancer's compass: right-click to read the land here.
item.realmlord.maotai.desc: Strength, Speed and regeneration for three minutes.
item.realmlord.medicinal_wine.desc: Regeneration and a shield of health.
item.realmlord.mengchong_warship.desc: Covered in rawhide: four seats, very tough, and it rams what it runs down.
item.realmlord.merchant_ship.desc: Three seats and a hold (crouch and right-click it to open).
item.realmlord.military_grain_pill.desc: One small pill sustains a soldier for a day.
item.realmlord.mooncake.desc: A mid-autumn sweet: a little absorption.
item.realmlord.noodle_soup.desc: Filling, and warms you: Speed for a while.
item.realmlord.peiyuan_pill.desc: Heals fully, with Resistance II and regeneration.
item.realmlord.pine_tar.desc: Caulking for boats; burns in torches.
item.realmlord.rainbow_silk.desc: Top-quality dyed silk cloth. The market pays well.
item.realmlord.rhino_horn_pill.desc: Cures poison and wither, and wards them off for two minutes.
item.realmlord.south_pointing_chariot.de: Right-click: points the way to your village.
item.realmlord.spring_talisman.desc: Use on the ground: the crops around grow at once.
item.realmlord.substitute_doll.desc: Carried: dies in your place, once.
item.realmlord.turreted_ship.desc: A floating fortress: six seats, crossbowmen and clapper poles.
item.realmlord.wooden_ox.desc: Right-click to set loose a saddled pack mule that is yours.
realmlord.activity.no_place: Has no place to work (build one, or give them another job)
realmlord.art.art_of_war.desc: Thirteen chapters. Know the enemy and know yourself, and in a hundred battles you will never be in peril.
realmlord.art.bajiquan.desc: Eight Extremities Fist: hits like thunder, kicks like an earthquake. A great fit with the spear.
realmlord.art.bajiquan.special: Cling to the Mountain: one blow in seven lands half again as hard and hurls the foe back.
realmlord.art.basic_breathing.desc: Breathing exercises every martial artist begins with.
realmlord.art.basic_sabre.desc: Cuts and guards with the sabre and sword.
realmlord.art.basic_spear.desc: Thrusts and sweeps with spear and polearm.
realmlord.art.daoyin.desc: Guiding and pulling the Qi: a clearer mind.
realmlord.art.five_animals_play.desc: Hua Tuo's exercises after the tiger, deer, bear, ape and crane.
realmlord.art.grass_floating.desc: A first lightness skill: run lighter and fall softer.
realmlord.art.green_dragon_blade.desc: Guan Yu's crescent blade, heavy as a mountain and quick as the wind.
realmlord.art.green_dragon_blade.special: Crescent Cleave: one stroke in seven cuts nearly double and staggers the foe.
realmlord.art.guicang_sword.desc: Gong Yangyu's sword art that gathers all sword arts.
realmlord.art.guicang_sword.special: Return to the Hidden: one blow in seven against you is turned aside.
realmlord.art.hell_slaughterer.desc: The barbarians' killing art, steeped in blood. It makes a slaughterer, and a hard man to like.
realmlord.art.hell_slaughterer.special: Slaughter: blows bite deeper into the wounded, and every kill heals you and lends you strength.
realmlord.art.hundred_pace_archery.desc: Yang Youji pierced a willow leaf at a hundred paces.
realmlord.art.hundred_pace_archery.speci: Hundred Paces: every arrow flies true and strikes as a critical hit.
realmlord.art.killing_sword.desc: The Qin army's sword art, refined on the battlefield: seven kills.
realmlord.art.killing_sword.special: Seven Kills: each kill feeds your strength for ten seconds.
realmlord.art.ladder_cloud_step.desc: Climbing the air as if by a ladder of cloud.
realmlord.art.ladder_cloud_step.special: Light Body: falls hurt far less.
realmlord.art.liuhe_spear.desc: The Liuhe spear, the spear Bajiquan pairs with.
realmlord.art.need_art: You must first train %s to level %s.
realmlord.art.need_comprehension: Your Comprehension (%s) is too low for a %s-rank art: it needs %s.
realmlord.art.overlord_halberd.desc: The Hegemon-King of Western Chu's strength could uproot mountains.
realmlord.art.overlord_halberd.special: Overlord's Sweep: one stroke in six sweeps through every foe around you.
realmlord.art.son_of_heaven_fist.desc: The dragon's fist of one who founds a country.
realmlord.art.son_of_heaven_fist.special: Dragon Strike: one punch in ten bursts outward, striking every foe around.
realmlord.art.taizu_long_fist.desc: Emperor Taizu of Song's long-range fist.
realmlord.art.tooltip.damage: +%s%% damage with the art's weapons per level
realmlord.art.tooltip.use: Right-click to learn it (the manual is used up). Then train it: fight with its weapons, or meditate (crouch and keep still) for cultivation methods; run for lightness skills.
realmlord.art.war_soldier_code.desc: A rare cultivation method made for battlefield soldiers.
realmlord.art.war_soldier_code.special: Fighting Intent: when badly hurt, killing intent rises: Strength II and Resistance for a minute (once every five).
realmlord.art.wugou_heart_sutra.desc: Unsullied. The heart pure and calm, no impure thoughts. To be cultivated from youth.
realmlord.art.yang_family_spear.desc: The Yang family's Lihua spear: attacks like a needle, returns like thread.
realmlord.art.yang_family_spear.special: Throat Killing Spear: one thrust in eight strikes double and leaves the foe weak and slow.
realmlord.art.yellow_court_scripture: Yellow Court Internal Scripture: Qi Cultivation
realmlord.art.yellow_court_scripture.des: The Qi-cultivation scroll of the Yellow Court Scripture. Needs the Yellow Emperor technique trained to the full.
realmlord.art.yellow_court_scripture.spe: Nourishing Qi: wounds close by themselves.
realmlord.art.yellow_emperor_internal.de: One of the strongest internal arts: completed, one's Qi turns golden.
realmlord.art.yellow_emperor_internal.sp: Golden Qi Shield: when struck, a shield of Qi absorbs the next blows (every half minute).
realmlord.art.yijin_jing.desc: The Yijin Jing: tendons like iron.
realmlord.art.yuenu_sword.desc: The Maiden of Yue's sword, quick as a falling leaf.
realmlord.art.yuenu_sword.special: Flurry: one cut in seven strikes twice.
realmlord.bag.no_territory: A Resources Bag empties into a territory's stores. Found your village first.
realmlord.bag.opened: %s Resources Bag emptied: %s food, %s wood, %s stone and %s iron ore added to the stores of %s.
realmlord.bag.tooltip: Holds %s food, %s wood, %s stone and %s iron ore.
realmlord.bag.tooltip.use: Use to empty it into your territory's stores.
realmlord.beastwave.begins: Night falls on the new year: the beastwave has begun!
realmlord.beastwave.next: The next beastwave strikes on the new year of Gaia year %s, in %s days.
realmlord.beastwave.no_sleep: You can't sleep while beasts are at the gates.
realmlord.beastwave.over: Dawn breaks and the beasts withdraw. The beastwave is over.
realmlord.beastwave.rank: Defender #%s: %s, %s beasts slain, rewarded with %s gold.
realmlord.beastwave.tonight: The beastwave comes tonight! Close your gates and arm your militia.
realmlord.beastwave.unseen: Wave %s struck %s while no one was near: %s food lost, %s residents killed.
realmlord.beastwave.warning: The beasts of the wilds are stirring. The beastwave will strike every village on the night of the lunar new year, in %s days.
realmlord.beastwave.wave: Wave %s of %s: %s beasts come out of the wilds against %s!
realmlord.blueprint.learn.done: Your village has learned the %s blueprint. Build it as often as you like.
realmlord.blueprint.learn.known: Your village already knows the %s blueprint. Keep this one, give it away or sell it at the market.
realmlord.blueprint.learn.no_village: Only a Lord can teach a blueprint (%s) to their village; found yours first.
realmlord.blueprint.tooltip.keep: Needed to construct it. Construction arrives in Phase 2; keep it safe.
realmlord.blueprint.tooltip.learn: Right-click to teach it to your village: build it as often as you like from then on.
realmlord.build.commission: Commission it from the village: %s timber, %s stone, about %s hours of work. Click the same spot again to commission (crouch to build it yourself).
realmlord.build.confirm: Crouch and right-click the same spot to build.
realmlord.build.damaged: The %s in %s has been damaged (%s blocks lost). The builders are going to repair it.
realmlord.build.demolishing: Your builders will take down the %s and carry its materials back to the stores.
realmlord.build.err.blueprint: Your village has not learned this blueprint. Buy one at the market (or take one from bandits) and right-click it.
realmlord.build.err.border: It must stand inside your territory's border (arrow towers, sentry posts and outposts may also stand out on the wall).
realmlord.build.err.dimension: You must be in your village's world to build there.
realmlord.build.err.fence_exists: The fence is already built or under construction.
realmlord.build.err.gate: That would block a gateway in the fence.
realmlord.build.err.grade: Your village is not yet of the grade to build this.
realmlord.build.err.lane: Leave a lane of three blocks between buildings, for a path.
realmlord.build.err.manor: Leave the Lord's Manor yard clear.
realmlord.build.err.no_water: This must be built at the water's edge: put part of it over water.
realmlord.build.err.not_placed: That building is not placed by hand.
realmlord.build.err.on_fence: Only an arrow tower or sentry post can stand on the fence.
realmlord.build.err.path: A path or paved area is laid there. Take it up first (select it on the map and Demolish).
realmlord.build.err.resources: Not enough wood or stone in the stores.
realmlord.build.err.slope: The ground is too steep there.
realmlord.build.err.specialist: You need a resident with the right trade to build this.
realmlord.build.err.water: Too deep. Settlers fill in ponds, marsh and shallow water up to 3 blocks deep, but not this.
realmlord.build.lacking: You lack: %s (those parts will be left out).
realmlord.build.missing: Left out for want of materials: %s
realmlord.build.need_manual: You must learn <%s> to build from this plan.
realmlord.build.preview: %s: %s×%s×%s, %s blocks. The sparks mark where it will stand, its entrance facing you.
realmlord.build.staffed: %s has started work at the new %s.
realmlord.build.tooltip.author: Drawn by %s
realmlord.build.tooltip.use: Right-click the ground to see where it will stand and what it needs; crouch and right-click the same spot to build it from what you carry. An architect saves materials.
realmlord.building.academy.desc: A great academy of lecture halls and a library. Ten students learn half again as fast as at a school, and it prepares candidates for the imperial examination.
realmlord.building.ancestral_hall.desc: Where residents honour their ancestors. Raises culture and People's Thoughts.
realmlord.building.barracks.desc: Quarters and a drill yard for fifty militia. +6 Military.
realmlord.building.bathroom.desc: Improves sanitation and health. Lifts People's Thoughts.
realmlord.building.blacksmith_workshop.d: Makes farm tools such as axes and chisels. Needs a junior blacksmith. A blacksmith working here sells iron tools and weapons.
realmlord.building.chamber_of_commerce.d: A merchant house with a counting room and warehouse. Its merchant sends caravans of the village's goods to a capital and back, by road or by sea.
realmlord.building.clearing.desc: Ground the builders clear and level.
realmlord.building.clinic.desc: Medical treatment for the villagers. Needs a doctor.
realmlord.building.coal_mine.desc: A shaft into a coal seam: miners bring up coal for the forges and the market.
realmlord.building.commission.desc: A building raised by the village's craftsmen from a construction plan.
realmlord.building.copper_mine.desc: A shaft into a copper seam: miners bring up copper for the smiths and the market.
realmlord.building.dining_hall.desc: Where residents eat together. Lifts People's Thoughts; a cook can work here.
realmlord.building.dock.desc: A timber pier out into the water, built from the shore. Keeps the village's boats: two fishermen to each fishing boat in the storehouse, and ten sailors to enlist.
realmlord.building.farmland.desc: 10 mu of fields, 200 food per mu each harvest. Sow at Qingming (month 4) or early July (month 7); harvest three months later. Five farmers work it.
realmlord.building.granary.desc: Storage for the harvest. Raises the economy.
realmlord.building.grocery_shop.desc: Sells daily necessities. Needs a grocer, who then sells torches, candles and goods.
realmlord.building.grounds.desc: The builders bring the whole village ground to the level of the Lord's Manor, out to ten blocks past the Grade 3 wall.
realmlord.building.large_residential_cou: A great courtyard, every range two storeys high around a yard with a well. Straw beds for 100 residents.
realmlord.building.logging_field.desc: Speeds up timber: 10 wood per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.martial_arts_dojo.des: A training hall for martial arts. Needs a martial artist.
realmlord.building.mazu_temple.desc: A temple to Mazu, goddess of the sea, revealed only to villages by the sea. Fishermen and sailors put to sea under her protection. +5 People's Thoughts, +6 Cultural.
realmlord.building.medium_residential_co: A larger courtyard with a two-storey hall across the back and a wing down each side. Straw beds for 50 residents.
realmlord.building.military_camp.desc: The basic barracks, where farmers become militia (Phase 2b). Needs an officer.
realmlord.building.mining_field.desc: Speeds up iron ore: 2 ore per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.path.desc: A path or road laid across the village.
realmlord.building.private_school.desc: Teaches the village's children. Needs a scholar. Raises culture.
realmlord.building.quarry.desc: Speeds up stone: 5 stone per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.salt_field.desc: Evaporation pans by the water: salt makers rake out about 15 salt a day each.
realmlord.building.sentry_post.desc: Warns the territory when enemies approach. +5 Security.
realmlord.building.shipyard.desc: A slipway into the water, run by a shipbuilder. Builds fishing boats, cima boats, merchant ships and, with the warship manual, Mengchong and turreted warships. +20 sailors.
realmlord.building.simple_fence.desc: A wooden palisade around the whole territory border: oak planks three blocks high, set into the ground, with spruce posts and lanterns. You choose where the gates go; each gateway has a beam, a little tiled roof and lanterns. From Town Grade 1 it gains battlements and a wall-walk behind them. +10 Security.
realmlord.building.small_residential_cou: A walled courtyard in the old style: a hall across the back and a wing down each side around a yard. Straw beds for 20 residents (23 in all), who sleep here at night.
realmlord.building.stable.desc: Keeps horses. A stableman working here sells saddles and leads.
realmlord.building.stone_outpost.desc: A sturdy stone outpost with an early-warning post. +5 Security.
realmlord.building.tailor_workshop.desc: Sews clothing. Needs a tailor, who then sells clothing and cloth.
realmlord.building.temple.desc: A place of worship. Lifts People's Thoughts and culture.
realmlord.building.village_temple.desc: A small Taoist temple on a terrace, kept by a priest who blesses, wards, prays for rain, refines elixirs or draws talismans. +4 People's Thoughts.
realmlord.building.weapons_workshop.desc: Makes weapons and armour. Needs an advanced blacksmith.
realmlord.camp.choose: What becomes of the bandit camp? %s  %s
realmlord.camp.keep_tip: Leave the tents, pen and campfire standing where they are.
realmlord.camp.not_now: There is no cleared bandit camp waiting for your decision.
realmlord.camp.salvage_tip: Take the whole camp apart: every pole, cloth, bar, log, barrel and the campfire comes back to you as materials, with anything left inside, and the ground grows over.
realmlord.camp.salvaged: You take the bandit camp apart and carry off %s items of materials. Nothing of it remains.
realmlord.camp.salvaged_spoils: %s salvaged materials were set aside for your village's stores.
realmlord.camp.salvaged_stores: %s salvaged materials went straight into your village's stores.
realmlord.chest.sort.tip: Merge part stacks and put like with like.
realmlord.chest.store_all.tip: Put everything in your inventory (not your hotbar) in here.
realmlord.chest.take_all.tip: Take everything that fits into your inventory.
realmlord.class.bailiff.desc: A constable who hunts down outlaws and drags them to justice. Skills: Iron Shackles, Arrest, Patrol Sense.
realmlord.class.chivalrous_expert.desc: A wandering swordsman of the martial world, swift and deadly alone. Skills: Swift Sword, Lightness Skill, Hundred Strikes.
realmlord.class.general.desc: A commander who leads from the front. Skills: War Cry, Cavalry Charge, Unyielding Will.
realmlord.class.healer.desc: A physician of the battlefield who mends allies and pins foes with needles. Skills: Rejuvenate, Acupuncture Needle, Purify.
realmlord.class.priest.desc: A Taoist priest versed in the classics, talismans and elixirs, who later presides over temples. Skills: Thunder Talisman, Golden Elixir, Exorcism Seal.
realmlord.class.strategist.desc: A master of stratagems who wins battles before they begin. Skills: Fire Stratagem, Confusion Array, Battle Insight.
realmlord.clear.cancel_hint: %s x %s. Calling it off stops the work; what's done stays done.
realmlord.clear.done: The %s x %s clearing in %s is level.
realmlord.clear.err.big: That area is too large: 48 x 48 blocks at most.
realmlord.clear.err.nothing: There is nothing there to level: it's all buildings, paths, the fence or the manor yard.
realmlord.clear.err.others: That ground lies in another Lord's territory.
realmlord.clear.err.site: A building site is in the way. Wait until it's finished, or mark out ground around it.
realmlord.clear.err.small: Mark out at least 2 x 2 blocks.
realmlord.clear.hint: Builders fell the trees, cut away the ground above the level and fill dips below it with earth, keeping everything useful in the stores. The edges are sloped so no cliff is left. Finished buildings, paths, the fence and the manor yard are left as they are.
realmlord.clear.slope.tip: Slope: shape the ground into an even ramp from the ground at the first corner to the ground at the second, for a way up onto raised ground. Flat: one level.
realmlord.clear.started: Builders will clear and level %s x %s blocks at height %s (about %s blocks to cut, %s to fill).
realmlord.clear.title: Clear & level
realmlord.cmd.capitals_note: The novel's nine Imperial Capitals, where they stand in an Earth Online: China world. Luoyang is the centre of the world.
realmlord.cmd.info.head: %s: %s (%s), level %s, %s, %s merit
realmlord.cmd.info.innate: Body Structure %s, Comprehension %s, Luck %s, Charm %s, reputation %s
realmlord.cmd.info.none: %s has not chosen a path yet.
realmlord.cmd.info.stats: Command %s, Force %s, Intelligence %s, Politics %s, %s points unspent
realmlord.cmd.reset: Reset %s. They will choose their path again.
realmlord.cmd.territories.none: No villages have been founded yet.
realmlord.coin.break: Use: break one coin into 100 of the coin below
realmlord.coin.combine: Sneak + use: change 100 coins into one of the coin above
realmlord.coin.need: You need %s %s to change them up.
realmlord.commission.err.craftsman: The village needs a carpenter or a mason to raise this.
realmlord.commission.err.not_lord: Only the Lord can commission buildings from the village.
realmlord.commission.started: The village's craftsmen will build %s: %s timber and %s stone from the stores, about %s hours of work.
realmlord.companion.err.busy: They hold an office or serve in the militia.
realmlord.companion.err.many: At most %s companions can walk with you.
realmlord.companion.err.talent: Only talents and figures from history can be companions.
realmlord.companion.err.wounded: They are wounded and resting until tomorrow.
realmlord.companion.hint: Talents can walk with you and fight at your side (%s of %s companions now).
realmlord.companion.title: Companion
realmlord.companion.wounded: %s was struck down and carried home to recover until tomorrow.
realmlord.craft.antidote: Poison can't take hold of you for two minutes.
realmlord.craft.chariot: Your manor lies %s blocks to the %s.
realmlord.craft.chariot.none: The figure points south, as ever. (You have no village to point to.)
realmlord.craft.doll: The substitute doll dies in your place.
realmlord.craft.luopan.territory: In %s's land, %s blocks from the manor
realmlord.den.cleared: The %2$s is slain! The den lies quiet for %1$s days.
realmlord.den.found: You have found a beast den at %s, %s: the lair of a %s.
realmlord.design.arch_bridge.desc: A stone arch bridge; build it from one bank.
realmlord.design.beacon_tower.desc: A signal fire on a stone tower.
realmlord.design.courtyard_house.desc: A courtyard house of four wings.
realmlord.design.irrigated_field.desc: A sown field with a channel.
realmlord.design.lighthouse.desc: A light for the harbour mouth.
realmlord.design.relay_station.desc: Stalls, hay and water for post horses.
realmlord.design.road_inn.desc: A hall with tables, a counter and beds.
realmlord.design.taoist_shrine.desc: A Taoist temple on a terrace.
realmlord.design.village_well.desc: A stone well with a roof.
realmlord.design.wharf.desc: A pier out into the water; build it from the shore.
realmlord.draft.architects_only: Only an architect can draw plans.
realmlord.draft.drawn: Drawn: a plan %s×%s×%s, %s blocks. Rename it on an anvil.
realmlord.draft.paper: You need a sheet of paper to draw on.
realmlord.draft.second: Marked %s×%s×%s (your largest: %s). Crouch and right-click to draw it.
realmlord.draft.sizes: Largest plan by rank: Junior %s, Intermediate %s, Advanced %s, Master %s blocks across.
realmlord.draft.tip: Right-click two corners of something you built; crouch and right-click (with paper) to draw it into a plan.
realmlord.draft.too_big: Too big to draw: your largest plan is %s blocks across.
realmlord.exam.none: None of %s's candidates passed the imperial examination of Year %s.
realmlord.exam.results: The imperial examination of Year %2$s: %1$s has %3$s new Xiucai, %4$s new Juren and %5$s new Jinshi.
realmlord.exam.token: A King-rank Summoning Token for %s's Zhuangyuan is in the manor storehouse.
realmlord.exam.zhuangyuan: %s of %s came first in the palace examination: Zhuangyuan! A Summoning Token was sent to the manor storehouse.
realmlord.exam.zhuangyuan.world: %s of %s is this year's Zhuangyuan, first in the palace examination.
realmlord.fence.moved: The old wall will be taken down (three quarters of it comes back) and the new one raised on the Grade %s ring, %s blocks out.
realmlord.fence.refit: Your builders are rebuilding the fence of %s to its new design.
realmlord.figure.bai_qi.desc: Warring States: Qin's war god, victor at Changping.
realmlord.figure.baili_xi.desc: Spring and Autumn: minister of Qin, bought for five ram skins.
realmlord.figure.ban_chao.desc: Eastern Han: general who secured the Western Regions.
realmlord.figure.ban_gu.desc: Eastern Han: historian of the Book of Han.
realmlord.figure.bao_zheng.desc: Northern Song: upright judge, Lord Bao.
realmlord.figure.bi_sheng.desc: Northern Song: inventor of movable type.
realmlord.figure.cai_lun.desc: Eastern Han: official credited with improving papermaking.
realmlord.figure.cao_ren.desc: Three Kingdoms: Wei general, defender of Fancheng.
realmlord.figure.cao_shen.desc: Western Han: second chancellor of the Han.
realmlord.figure.chen_ping.desc: Western Han: Han strategist and chancellor.
realmlord.figure.deng_ai.desc: Three Kingdoms: Wei general who took Shu.
realmlord.figure.deng_yu.desc: Eastern Han: general of the Han restoration.
realmlord.figure.di_qing.desc: Northern Song: Song general of the southwest.
realmlord.figure.dong_zhongshu.desc: Western Han: Confucian scholar of the Han.
realmlord.figure.du_yu.desc: Western Jin: Jin general and scholar.
realmlord.figure.err.loyalty: They are not yet loyal enough to teach you.
realmlord.figure.err.no_art: They have no martial art to teach.
realmlord.figure.err.not_figure: Only the summoned historical figures have arts of their own to teach.
realmlord.figure.err.not_lord: Only the Lord may ask this of them.
realmlord.figure.err.taught: They have already taught you their art.
realmlord.figure.fan_kuai.desc: Western Han: Han warrior of the Hongmen feast.

realmlord.guide.page.1:
§lThe Lord's Handbook§r

Gaia is a world where Lords found villages, raise towns and gather the talents of history.

This book covers the village: founding it, building it and keeping it.
realmlord.guide.page.10:
§lFood§r

Everyone eats one food a day: grain first, then flour, meat and fish.

Sow farmland in month 4 or 7 for a full harvest three months later. Watch Records for how long the food lasts.
realmlord.guide.page.11:
§lThe Market§r

Buy and sell goods at the novel's prices. Take puts goods from the stores into your pack (shift for a stack); Hand In puts them back.

The storehouse chest keeps anything else.
realmlord.guide.page.12:
§lGoods§r

Three Flower Wine: drink for strength.
Medicinal Herbs: eat to heal.
Fire Oil: throw it to set the ground alight.
Salt, linen and fine silk: trade goods.

Workshops make them each day.
realmlord.guide.page.13:
§lYour Land§r

Only you and those you trust may build or open chests here.

/realm trust <name>
/realm untrust <name>
/realm trusted

The manor's chests are yours alone.
realmlord.guide.page.14:
§lGrowing§r

Upgrade from the Overview when you have the people, title and buildings. At Grade 2 the manor becomes your own residence.

Lost this book? /realm guide
realmlord.guide.page.2:
§lFounding§r

Finish the Village Creation quest (Quest tab), then use the token on open ground and name your village.

The Lord's Manor rises there. Right-click its seal to run your land.
realmlord.guide.page.3:
§lThe Manor§r

Overview: your people, mood, safety, treasury and the next upgrade.

Construction, People, Market and Records, and the Map button, are along the top.
realmlord.guide.page.4:
§lBuilding§r

Pick a building in Construction and place it on the map or in the world. Wood and stone come from the stores.

Builders clear, level and raise it block by block. More builders, faster work.
realmlord.guide.page.5:
§lBlueprints§r

Most buildings need a blueprint. Right-click one to teach it to your village for good; then build as many as you like.

Buy them on the market's Special Items platform.
realmlord.guide.page.6:
§lThe Map§r

Press M for the world map.

The manor's map shows your land. From it: lay paths, clear and level ground, set fence gates, and pick a building to demolish.
realmlord.guide.page.7:
§lThe Fence§r

A plank palisade around your border, with gates where you choose. Once it stands, no monsters spawn inside.

Arrow towers placed near it stand in the wall. Towns add a walkway on top.
realmlord.guide.page.8:
§lPeople§r

Residents need beds: ten in the manor at first, then 20, 50 or 100 per courtyard. Newcomers only come to a free bed.

Right-click a resident for their card.
realmlord.guide.page.9:
§lThe Day§r

A village day is a Minecraft day. Sleep and the next day comes at once: work is paid, food eaten, taxes in, newcomers arrive.

The Records tab shows yesterday's ledger and the village log.

realmlord.panel.territory.none_lord: You have no territory yet. Complete the Village Creation quest, then use your Village Creation Token on the ground where your village should stand. The first villages in the world earn the most merit.
realmlord.panel.territory.order: Founded: village no. %s in the world
realmlord.panel.territory.req_index: Politics, economy, culture and military indexes of %s
realmlord.panel.territory.world: Villages in the world: %s · Gold token: %s
realmlord.panel.title: Character
realmlord.path.area.tip: Paved area: click two opposite corners (up to %1$s x %1$s blocks) to pave a square, a market place or a yard. Path: click points along the way.
realmlord.path.err.area: A paved area can be at most 48 x 48 blocks.
realmlord.path.err.cost: The stores do not hold enough wood and stone for that path.
realmlord.path.err.empty: That path would run only through buildings or beyond the border.
realmlord.path.err.points: A path needs at least two points.
realmlord.path.err.unloaded: Part of that path is too far away to survey. Go closer and try again.
realmlord.path.hint: Click the map to add points along the way; right-click removes the last. Paths go around buildings and stop at the fence. Builders lay them, filling dips with earth.
realmlord.path.remove_hint: %s blocks. Demolishing it turns it back to grass and returns 3/4 of the cost of any part not yet laid.
realmlord.path.stairs.tip: Steps: the path keeps to the lie of the land, climbing or dropping one block at a time with stairs. Even: ditches are bridged and humps cut down.
realmlord.path.started: Builders will lay a %s path, %s blocks wide.
realmlord.path.title: New path
realmlord.pave.hint: Click one corner, then the opposite one; the area follows your mouse until you do. Click again to start over, or right-click to clear. Choose the surface, then Pave. The ground is evened out under it, as for a path.
realmlord.pave.tip: Pave a square, a market place or a yard: pick two opposite corners on the map, as for clearing ground (up to %1$s x %1$s blocks).
realmlord.pave.title: Pave an area
realmlord.pill.capped: %s is already %s; the pill can do no more.
realmlord.pill.enlightenment.desc: A special pill: raises Comprehension by 1 (up to 30).
realmlord.pill.healing.desc: Heals 4 hearts at once, keeps healing, and shields for a minute.
realmlord.pill.marrow.desc: A special pill: raises Body Structure by 1 (up to 30).
realmlord.pill.wound_powder.desc: Closes wounds: heals 2 hearts and a little more.
realmlord.place.hint: Right-click: place · Sneak + right-click: turn · Left-click: cancel
realmlord.plan.alchemy.desc: A Taoist's furnace notes. The clinic can refine Rejuvenation, Marrow Cleansing and Enlightenment pills.
realmlord.plan.lamellar.desc: Scales punched, rowed and laced. The smithy can make lamellar armour.
realmlord.plan.learned: Your masters have learned the manual: %s.
realmlord.plan.mountain_pattern.desc: The generals' armour of interlocking steel. The weapons workshop can make it.
realmlord.plan.polearms.desc: Spear, guandao and ji. The weapons workshop can forge polearms.
realmlord.plan.rations.desc: How an army's dry rations are baked, salted and packed. The grocer can make Military Rations.
realmlord.plan.siege_engines.desc: Bed crossbows, trebuchets and heavy bolts. The carpenter's workshop can build siege engines.
realmlord.plan.tiger_war.desc: The Tiger Soul Sabre and the tiger-hide war coat. Needs beast cores and tiger pelts in the storehouse.
realmlord.plan.tooltip: Right-click to teach it to your village's masters.
realmlord.plan.warships.desc: The lines of the Mengchong and the turreted ship. The shipyard can build warships.
realmlord.protect.denied: This is %s's land: ask its Lord to trust you.
realmlord.protect.trusted: %s may now build and use chests in %s.
realmlord.quest.bandits: The supplies are ready, but bandits have seized the settlers! Their camp lies near X %s, Z %s, to the %s, about %s blocks away. Drive them out.
realmlord.quest.bandits_lands: Bandits hold a camp in the Bandit Lands, a wild country of its own. Go when you are ready: you will arrive fifty blocks from their camp.
realmlord.quest.cache: You found the Bandit Chief's buried treasure.
realmlord.quest.camp_found: You have found the bandit camp. Defeat every bandit and their chief.
realmlord.quest.chief_down: The Bandit Chief has fallen. He dropped a ledger.
realmlord.quest.claimed: Village Creation quest complete! You received the village creation set: a %s Village Creation Token, a Summoning Token (%s) and a %s Resources Bag. Use the token on the ground where your village should stand.
realmlord.quest.cleared: The camp is cleared and %s captive families go free: %s people will follow you. They wait by the camp until you found your village. Open the Quest tab (J) to claim your reward.
realmlord.quest.failed_abandon: You abandoned the Village Creation quest.
realmlord.quest.failed_now_adventurer: Without settlers you cannot found a village. You continue as an Adventurer.
realmlord.quest.failed_time: You ran out of time. The settlers have scattered.
realmlord.quest.gold_world: %s has earned the only Gold Village Creation Token in the world!
realmlord.quest.not_needed: You already rule a village, so the Village Creation quest is not needed.
realmlord.quest.nothing: You carry nothing the settlers need. Supplies so far: logs %s/%s, stone %s/%s, food %s/%s.
realmlord.quest.spoils: Bandit spoils: %s village blueprints and %s gold coins are yours. Their stolen supplies (%s grain, %s wood, %s stone, %s iron ore) will go into your village's stores when you found it.
realmlord.quest.start: Village Creation quest: settlers are waiting for a lord to lead them. First gather supplies for them: %s logs, %s stone and %s food, then hand them over in the Quest tab of your panel (J). You have %s days. Finish within %s days for a Gold token; the slower you are, the lower the grade. The bandits are strong: get yourself iron armour first.
realmlord.quest.warning: Less than a day remains to finish the Village Creation quest.
realmlord.records.lasts: Lasts about %s days without a harvest.
realmlord.records.no_ledger: The first day's accounts come in tomorrow.
realmlord.refine.failed: The refining fails; the stone crumbles. Your gear is unharmed.
realmlord.refine.nothing: Hold a weapon or armour below Gold grade in your other hand.
realmlord.refine.tip: Right-click with gear in the other hand to raise it a grade (ungraded becomes Bronze). The higher the grade, the likelier it fails; failure costs only the stone.
realmlord.resident.name: Name: %s (%s)
realmlord.resident.no_workplace: No finished workplace needs a %s yet.
realmlord.resident.skill_hint: Their trade, rank and specialty make them %s%% better at their current work.
realmlord.resident.title: Resident
realmlord.restriction.sent_home: You have been returned to your territory.
realmlord.restriction.warning: A Lord may not leave their territory outside of war. Return within %s seconds or be sent home.
realmlord.role.adventurer_desc: Roam the world freely. Choose a combat occupation with levels and skills, or a trade that grows from Junior to Master. Adventurers learn a quarter faster, and their strength is entirely their own. Every character rolls innate Body Structure, Comprehension, Luck and Charm.
realmlord.role.combat_desc: Combat occupations have a character level (up to 100) and three skills each, learned at levels 1, 10 and 25. Each level gives 2 attribute points and every fifth level raises all four by 1. Experience is lost on death.
realmlord.role.lord_desc: Rule a territory. Earn a Village Creation Token through a demanding quest, found your village and raise it, grade by grade, into a town, county, prefecture and beyond. Merit raises your noble title, which every upgrade requires. You also pick a sub-profession.
realmlord.role.lord_restricted: On this world, Lords may not leave their territory except for war.
realmlord.role.subtitle: This choice cannot be undone.
realmlord.role.title: Choose Your Path
realmlord.role.work_desc: Work occupations have no character level, only a craft level from 1 to 10 (Junior, Intermediate, Advanced, Master). They never lose experience on death. A Lord with a trade still has a character level.
realmlord.sell.head: Good            Units    Fetches
realmlord.sell.none: The storehouse holds nothing the market buys. (Tools, gear and other things you keep stay there.)
realmlord.sell.title: Sell from the Storehouse
realmlord.ship.stats: %s seats · speed %s%% · hull %s%% of a boat's toughness
realmlord.skill.acupuncture_needle.desc: A needle to the pressure points pins your target in place.
realmlord.skill.arrest.desc: Haul your target to your feet.
realmlord.skill.battle_insight.desc: Every foe within 32 blocks glows, and your mind and eyes sharpen.
realmlord.skill.cavalry_charge.desc: Charge forward, striking and scattering the foes in your path.
realmlord.skill.confusion_array.desc: Foes near your target lose their quarry and are slowed and weakened.
realmlord.skill.exorcism_seal.desc: Seal the area you look at, harming and weakening every foe there. Undead suffer double.
realmlord.skill.fire_stratagem.desc: Set the spot you look at ablaze, burning and harming every foe there.
realmlord.skill.golden_elixir.desc: Share an elixir: you and nearby allies regenerate, resist fire and toughen.
realmlord.skill.hundred_strikes.desc: A storm of blows on every foe within reach.
realmlord.skill.iron_shackles.desc: Bind your target so it can barely move.
realmlord.skill.lightness_skill.desc: Move like the wind: speed, high leaps and a feather's fall.
realmlord.skill.none: You have no skill to use.
realmlord.skill.patrol_sense.desc: Every foe within 48 blocks is revealed, and you quicken your step.
realmlord.skill.purify.desc: Cleanse harmful effects and fire from yourself and nearby allies.
realmlord.skill.swift_sword.desc: Dash and cut through the enemies ahead.
realmlord.skill.thunder_talisman.desc: Burn a talisman to call thunder down on your target, harming and slowing it.
realmlord.skill.unyielding_will.desc: Steel yourself with heavy Absorption and Resistance.
realmlord.skill.war_cry.desc: You and nearby allies gain Strength and Resistance; nearby foes are weakened.
realmlord.spawn.arrived: You arrive at %s, %s. This is now where you wake.
realmlord.spawn.biome.coast.desc: A beach by the sea, with fish and open views.
realmlord.spawn.biome.forest.desc: Woodland with plenty of timber, and clearings to build in.
realmlord.spawn.biome.hills.desc: Hills and blossom groves, with stone close at hand.
realmlord.spawn.biome.jungle.desc: Hot, wet jungle, thick with growth.
realmlord.spawn.biome.plains.desc: Flat, open grassland: the easiest ground for a village to grow on.
realmlord.spawn.biome.river.desc: Beside a river: water, fertile banks and easy travel.
realmlord.spawn.biome.savanna.desc: Dry, warm grassland with scattered trees.
realmlord.spawn.biome.taiga.desc: Cool spruce forest: hard country, but rich in wood.
realmlord.spawn.china.central_plains.des: The heart of the land on the Yellow River: wide, flat, fertile farmland that is easy to build on. Open on every side, so easy to reach and hard to defend.
realmlord.spawn.china.fujian.desc: A hilly southern coast of harbours and green hills. Warm and out of the way.
realmlord.spawn.china.guanzhong.desc: The Wei River valley, ringed by mountains and guarded by passes. Fertile and easy to defend; many dynasties rose here.
realmlord.spawn.china.jiangnan.desc: The Yangtze delta: rivers, lakes and warm, wet country. Rich in food and close to the sea.
realmlord.spawn.china.jingxiang.desc: A crossroads on the Han River between north and south. Good land, but every army passes through.
realmlord.spawn.china.shanhai.desc: Where Ouyang Shuo founded Shanhai Village in the novel: a warm, fertile basin in the far south, ringed by mountains and opening onto the sea. Far from the great powers, with room to grow.
realmlord.spawn.china.sichuan.desc: The Land of Abundance: rich farmland walled in by mountains on every side. Safe and wealthy, but far from everywhere.
realmlord.spawn.china.youyan.desc: The northern frontier beyond the plains: cooler country near the mountains, with room to grow.
realmlord.spawn.china.yunnan.desc: Highland lakes and mountains in the far south-west. Remote, mild and beautiful.
realmlord.spawn.custom.desc: Anywhere on land. You will arrive on the nearest dry ground.
realmlord.spawn.err.far: That place is out of reach.
realmlord.spawn.err.placed: You have already chosen where to begin.
realmlord.spawn.err.sea: That is open water. Choose somewhere on land.
realmlord.spawn.hint: Scroll to zoom and drag to move the map. Click a red marker or anywhere on land, then press Begin here.
realmlord.spawn.title: Where Will You Begin?
realmlord.specialty.capable_administrato: Raises the political index more in administration.
realmlord.specialty.ore_seeker.desc: Digs more ore in the mining field.
realmlord.specialty.stonecutter.desc: Cuts more stone in the quarry.
realmlord.specialty.timber_sense.desc: Cuts more wood in the logging field.
realmlord.speed.tip: Creative testing: run the days and the village's work faster (x1, x5, x20, x60). Operators can also use /realm speed <n>.
realmlord.stat.command.desc: Command: how strong your troops are on the battlefield, how many you can lead, how easily you recruit and how quickly they respond. Now: your animals hit harder.
realmlord.stat.force.desc: Force: the power of special attacks and the chance of critical hits (0.25% per point, for half again the damage). Also adds to melee damage and strengthens physical skills.
realmlord.stat.intelligence.desc: Intelligence: lengthens buffs and controls, shortens skill cooldowns, widens your troops' vision and speeds weapon development.
realmlord.stat.politics.desc: Politics: how well your policies work on markets and farms, and how diplomacy goes. Matters once your territory grows.
realmlord.storage.hand_in.tip: Puts every log, plank, stone, iron ore, grain, meat, fish, leather and other trade good you carry into the village's stores, where builders and workshops use them and the market can sell them.
realmlord.storage.handed_in: %s items handed in to the village stores.
realmlord.storage.open.tip: The Lord's Manor storehouse: 54 slots to keep anything for later (salvaged materials, tools, loot). Kept with your territory.
realmlord.storage.sell.tip: Sells every trade good in the storehouse at market prices, less the 20% tax. Other items stay.
realmlord.storage.sort.tip: Tidy the whole storehouse: part stacks merged and like kept with like. It also tidies itself whenever it is opened.
realmlord.storage.title: %s Storehouse
realmlord.summoning.arrived: %s (%s rank) answers your summons. %s They join %s.
realmlord.summoning.no_village: Summoned figures come to your village: found one first.
realmlord.summoning.none_left: Every figure of that rank has already answered another Lord's call.
realmlord.summoning.not_yet: No talent answers the call yet. Keep the Summoning Token: it will work once historical figures arrive (Phase 3).
realmlord.summoning.tooltip: Summons a random %s historical figure to serve you.
realmlord.summoning.tooltip2: Use it to summon a historical figure of this rank to your village.
realmlord.summoning.world: %s has summoned a %s-rank figure from history: %s!
realmlord.tech.acupuncture.desc: Needles that heal another (or yourself) and clear what ails them.
realmlord.tech.animal_pen_plan.desc: A fenced pen with a gate, hay and water.
realmlord.tech.animal_salve.desc: A salve that heals an animal fully.
realmlord.tech.architects_drafting.desc: The architect's drafting square: draw what you have built into a plan, and raise it again anywhere.
realmlord.tech.arrow_tower_plan.desc: A wooden arrow tower with slits and a railed platform.
realmlord.tech.beacon_tower_plan.desc: A stone beacon tower with battlements and a signal fire.
realmlord.tech.beast_whistle.desc: A tusk whistle that calls all your animals to you.
realmlord.tech.bianque_classic.desc: The special pills without a beast core.
realmlord.tech.bole_horse_classic.desc: Horse feed: heals, quickens and gentles a horse.
realmlord.tech.brigandine.desc: The Ming brigandine: plates riveted inside a padded linen coat, the brass studs showing.
realmlord.tech.buren_armour: Song Dynasty Buren Armor Making Manual
realmlord.tech.buren_armour.desc: The Song infantry's heavy armour of nearly two thousand scales: hard to knock down.
realmlord.tech.cima_boat.desc: The fleet's scout: a red-sailed boat half again as fast as any other.
realmlord.tech.clear_heart_pill.desc: A pill that clears the head and limbs of every sluggishness.
realmlord.tech.coal_mining.desc: Coal, iron, copper and gold ore you mine now and then yield more.
realmlord.tech.compost.desc: Turning scraps and leaves into fertiliser.
realmlord.tech.cormorant_fishing.desc: Trained cormorants bring in a third more fish.
realmlord.tech.courtyard_house_plan.desc: A courtyard house: four wings around a garden, a red gate at the front.
realmlord.tech.dock_plan.desc: A wooden pier out into the water: build it from the shore.
realmlord.tech.dragon_robe.desc: The yellow dragon robe. Whoever wears it is received like a hero.
realmlord.tech.dried_fish.desc: Salted, dried fish that keeps and fills.
realmlord.tech.dukang_wine.desc: The wine of Du Kang, father of wine.
realmlord.tech.dumplings.desc: Pork dumplings, four at a time.
realmlord.tech.fan_shengzhi.desc: The Han agricultural classic: crops around you grow faster.
realmlord.tech.ferry_plan.desc: Stone steps down to the water for a ferry.
realmlord.tech.fishing_boat.desc: An ordinary fishing boat that carries two fishermen; fish caught from it come in a third more often.
realmlord.tech.fishing_hut_plan.desc: A hut on stilts over the water.
realmlord.tech.forge_plan.desc: A smithy: blast furnace, anvil, grindstone and a chimney.
realmlord.tech.glass_making.desc: Glass from sand and coal, and more panes from each pane of glass.
realmlord.tech.glazed_tiles.desc: Imperial yellow and jade-green glazed tiles, and slate roof tiles.
realmlord.tech.granary_plan.desc: A raised granary that keeps the grain dry.
realmlord.tech.great_wall.desc: Deepslate bricks by the eight, and stone breaks half again as fast in your hands.
realmlord.tech.guardian_charm.desc: Carried, it saves one of your animals from death once.
realmlord.tech.herb_garden_plan.desc: Beds of medicinal flowers between paths.
realmlord.tech.herbal_formulary.desc: Gathering herbs from wild flowers, and a detox draught against poison.
realmlord.tech.horse_barding.desc: Iron, gold and diamond barding for war horses.
realmlord.tech.horse_medicine.desc: A tonic that makes a horse fast and sure-footed for five minutes.
realmlord.tech.hundred_beasts.desc: Your tamed animals strike a third harder and heal as they fight.
realmlord.tech.hundred_refined.desc: Forge a steel blade again, folding in three more bars of refined steel and gold: it comes out Gold grade without a beast core.
realmlord.tech.immortal_brew.desc: Li Bai's own: luck and strength for ten minutes.
realmlord.tech.iron_armored_beast.desc: Animals you tame come out tougher: +20 health and +6 armour.
realmlord.tech.ironware_casting.desc: Casting chain, iron bars and cauldrons with less iron.
realmlord.tech.irrigated_field_plan.desc: A sown field with a water channel down the middle.
realmlord.tech.jade_carving.desc: A jade pendant: held in the off hand, it brings luck and health.
realmlord.tech.kaogong_ji.desc: The Records of Trades of the Rites of Zhou: two more blocks of reach.
realmlord.tech.kitchen_plan.desc: An open kitchen: stove, smoker, water and a table.
realmlord.tech.lifebuoy.desc: Held in the off hand in water: breathe and swim fast.
realmlord.tech.lighthouse_plan.desc: A stone lighthouse for the harbour mouth.
realmlord.tech.lime_mortar.desc: Stone bricks laid in lime mortar, no kiln needed.
realmlord.tech.luopan.desc: The geomancer's compass: reads the land wherever you stand.
realmlord.tech.manchu_han_feast.desc: The imperial banquet: one dish of it fills you and lends every strength.
realmlord.tech.mazu_charts.desc: The sea goddess's favour: one catch in ten brings a treasure up with it.
realmlord.tech.medicinal_wine.desc: Herbs steeped in wine: heals and steadies.
realmlord.tech.meng_chong.desc: The rawhide-covered warship built to ram: four seats, four times as tough as a boat; it strikes and throws aside what it runs down.
realmlord.tech.merchant_ship.desc: A trading ship: three seats and a hold.
realmlord.tech.military_grain_pill.desc: One small pill sustains a soldier for a day.
realmlord.tech.ming_shipbuilding.desc: Harbour lights and the diving bell for hull work.
realmlord.tech.mingguang_armour.desc: The bright-light armour of the Tang cavalry, two polished mirrors on the breast.
realmlord.tech.movable_type.desc: Bi Sheng's press: paper and books in quantity.
realmlord.tech.need_trade: Only a %s of %s rank or higher can learn this.
realmlord.tech.net_weaving.desc: A casting net: throw it on water for fish.
realmlord.tech.night_clothes.desc: The night-walker's black hood and suit. Crouching in the dark, unseen beyond a few paces.
realmlord.tech.pagoda_plan.desc: A five-storey pagoda with eaves on every floor.
realmlord.tech.paifang_plan.desc: A stone memorial archway with a golden tablet.
realmlord.tech.panda_rearing.desc: Bamboo feed that makes pandas breed and cubs grow.
realmlord.tech.pavilion_plan.desc: A roadside pavilion with red pillars and double eaves.
realmlord.tech.pearl_diving.desc: Hold your breath far longer under water.
realmlord.tech.peiyuan_pill.desc: Solidifies the primordial Qi: effective for the badly injured.
realmlord.tech.perfusing_steel.desc: The Northern and Southern dynasties' steelmaking: molten pig iron poured over wrought iron. Refined steel without tiger bone, and black iron straight from raw iron.
realmlord.tech.pine_tar.desc: Pine tar for hulls, and tar torches.
realmlord.tech.porcelain.desc: Blue-and-white porcelain vases: the market pays well.
realmlord.tech.qimin_fodder.desc: Fodder that readies any farm animal to breed, or grows a young one.
realmlord.tech.rammed_earth.desc: Packed earth walls from dirt, gravel and clay.
realmlord.tech.recipe_unknown: You don't know how to make that: it needs a technical manual.
realmlord.tech.relay_station_plan.desc: A courier relay: stalls, hay and water for the post horses.
realmlord.tech.rhino_horn_pill: Rhino Horn Poison Curing Pill Formula
realmlord.tech.rhino_horn_pill.desc: Bianque's antidote: cures poison and wither, and wards them off for two minutes.
realmlord.tech.rice_noodles.desc: A bowl of beef noodle soup.
realmlord.tech.road_inn_plan.desc: An inn for the roads between cities: a hall with tables, a counter and beds.
realmlord.tech.sea_salt.desc: Boiling sea water down for salt.
realmlord.tech.sericulture.desc: Raising silkworms on leaves for their cocoons.
realmlord.tech.shipyard_plan.desc: A slipway into the water, framed and craned, with the shipwright's benches.
realmlord.tech.silk_reeling.desc: Reeling silk from cocoons, and dyeing the top-quality rainbow silk cloth.
realmlord.tech.song_bow_crossbow: Song Dynasty Bow and Crossbow Making Manual
realmlord.tech.song_bow_crossbow.desc: The composite bow of birch, sinew and fish glue, and Zhuge Liang's repeating crossbow.
realmlord.tech.south_pointing_chariot.de: The geared carriage whose figure always points south, and here also home.
realmlord.tech.spring_weathering.desc: A talisman that brings spring to the fields around it at once.
realmlord.tech.stable_plan.desc: A stable with stalls, hay and water troughs.
realmlord.tech.star_guiding.desc: Zheng He's navigation by the stars: see in the dark on the water, and swim like a dolphin.
realmlord.tech.stone_dressing.desc: Cobblestone dressed into bricks; cracked and carved bricks.
realmlord.tech.substitute_doll.desc: A wooden doll that dies in your place, once.
realmlord.tech.tang_sword_forging.desc: The Tang hengdao, straight and single-edged, and the great mo dao that cut down horse and rider.
realmlord.tech.tea_brewing.desc: Lu Yu's art of tea: green tea that sharpens the hands.
realmlord.tech.tiger_bone_wine.desc: A tiger bone steeped in wine.
realmlord.tech.tooltip.builds: Builds: %s (its plan comes with the manual)
realmlord.tech.tooltip.passive: A technique: works for you once learned.
realmlord.tech.tooltip.use: Right-click to learn it (the manual is used up).
realmlord.tech.turreted_ship.desc: The floating fortress with watertight bulkheads: six seats, seven times as tough, crossbowmen who shoot at foes and clapper poles that strike those close. Its master has Conduit Power in water.
realmlord.tech.village_temple_plan.desc: A Taoist temple on a raised terrace, red pillars and a tiled roof, for a priest to preside over.
realmlord.tech.village_well_plan.desc: A stone well with a roof over it.
realmlord.tech.wild_beast_taming.desc: The wild era's taming art: wolves, cats, parrots and horses take to you at the first try.
realmlord.tech.wooden_ox.desc: Zhuge Liang's pack carrier: a saddled, laden mule that follows you.
realmlord.tech.yingzao_fashi.desc: The Song court's building standards: one block in five you place is not used up.
realmlord.tech.zhaozhou_bridge_plan.desc: Li Chun's stone arch bridge, seventeen blocks long: build it from one bank across the water.
realmlord.temple.priest_came: A wandering Taoist priest, %s, came to %s to keep the %s (%s from the treasury).
realmlord.token.tooltip.black_iron: Earned by finishing the quest within 7.5 days.
realmlord.token.tooltip.bronze: The most common token. Most villages begin this way.
realmlord.token.tooltip.gold: Earned by finishing within 3 days. There is only one in all the world.
realmlord.token.tooltip.name: You name the village when you found it.
realmlord.token.tooltip.silver: Earned by finishing the quest within 5 days.
realmlord.token.tooltip.use: Use on the ground to found your village there.
realmlord.trade.departed: %s led a caravan out of %s for %s with %s of goods; back in %s days.
realmlord.trade.need_items: You do not have enough to sell.
realmlord.trade.no_workshop: Needs a workshop to work in first.
realmlord.trade.returned: A caravan came home to %s from %s: %s to the treasury after %s tax.
realmlord.trade.robbed: Bandits robbed %s's caravan on the road to %s: %s of goods lost.
realmlord.trade.robbed_sea: Water bandits took %s's merchant ship on the way to %s: %s of goods lost.

realmlord.work.architect.desc: Learns by building. Reach grows with rank, and the Architect will matter for construction in your territory.
realmlord.work.blacksmith.desc: Learns by forging metal weapons, tools and armour, and smelting ingots. From Intermediate rank on, gear you forge comes out with Unbreaking.
realmlord.work.breeder.desc: Learns by breeding animals. Higher ranks are blessed with twins more and more often.
realmlord.work.carpenter.desc: Learns by felling trees and making wooden goods. You chop wood faster.
realmlord.work.cook.desc: Learns by cooking and preparing food. Meals fill you more.
realmlord.work.farmer.desc: Learns by tilling and harvesting ripe crops. Higher ranks reap extra harvest.
realmlord.work.fisherman.desc: Learns by fishing. Higher ranks often pull up a second catch.
realmlord.work.mason.desc: Learns by quarrying and dressing stone. You cut stone faster.
realmlord.work.physician.desc: Learns by brewing potions. All healing you receive is stronger, and higher ranks sometimes brew a bonus potion.
realmlord.work.shipbuilder.desc: Learns by building boats. You swim faster and waste less timber.
realmlord.work.tailor.desc: Learns by making leather armour, wool, carpets, beds and banners. From Intermediate rank on, leather armour you sew carries Protection.
realmlord.work.veterinarian.desc: Learns by feeding, breeding and taming animals. Animals you feed recover, and your own animals take less damage.
realmlord.work.winemaker.desc: Learns by brewing and preparing sugar and honey. Potions you drink last longer.
realmlord.workshop.also_needs: Also uses %s %s from the storehouse each time (%s there).
realmlord.workshop.dismiss: Call them back to other work
realmlord.workshop.err.busy: They are busy (a soldier, an official, a companion, running a building, or already learning).
realmlord.workshop.err.master: They are already an Advanced master of this trade.
realmlord.workshop.err.plan: Your village hasn't learned the manual for that.
realmlord.workshop.makes_items: Each day: %s graded item(s) for the storehouse, from %3$s %2$s each. The master's skill sets the grade (Bronze, Black Iron, Silver, now and then Gold).
realmlord.workshop.makes_named_from: Each day: %s %s into the storehouse, from %s %s each time. Arms and armour are graded by the master's skill.
realmlord.workshop.makes_stock_from: Each day: %s %s from %s %s, into the stores.
realmlord.workshop.mode.accounts.desc: The abacus and the ledger. Students become grocers.
realmlord.workshop.mode.archery.desc: The bow: some Force and soldier's experience. Pupils become hunters.
realmlord.workshop.mode.archery_drill.de: At the butts: a little more of both Force and experience.
realmlord.workshop.mode.blessing.desc: Incense, festivals and weddings: People's Thoughts +3 (+1 for each rank of the priest).
realmlord.workshop.mode.classics.desc: The Four Books: Intelligence and Politics. Students become scholars.
realmlord.workshop.mode.drill.desc: The ordinary daily drill: Force and soldier's experience for the militia.
realmlord.workshop.mode.exam_prep.desc: The eight-legged essay and the classics, for the imperial examination: students here pass far more often.
realmlord.workshop.mode.fist_and_palm.de: The foundation: pupils gain 1 Force a day and steady soldier's experience. They become martial artists.
realmlord.workshop.mode.formation.desc: Marching in ranks: far more soldier's experience, less Force; officers' Command grows faster.
realmlord.workshop.mode.internal_arts.de: Breathing and Qi cultivation: Force rises fast (up to 92), little soldier's experience, and the lessons take 25 days.
realmlord.workshop.mode.medicine.desc: Herbs and pulse-reading: Intelligence. Students become doctors for the clinic.
realmlord.workshop.mode.patrol.desc: The militia walks the lanes and the wall: Security rises each day, but they drill little.
realmlord.workshop.mode.qinggong.desc: Lightness skill: a short course of 15 days. Pupils become martial artists sooner but less strong.
realmlord.workshop.mode.rain_prayer.desc: Rites for good weather: the crops yield 10% more (+3% for each rank of the priest).
realmlord.workshop.mode.rest.desc: A day off: no drill, and every soldier's loyalty rises.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_changan.de: Caravans of the village's goods to Chang'an and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_chengdu.de: Caravans of the village's goods to Chengdu and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_dali.desc: Caravans of the village's goods to Dali and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_jianye.des: Caravans of the village's goods to Jianye and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_jingdu.des: Caravans of the village's goods to Jingdu and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_luoyang.de: Caravans of the village's goods to Luoyang and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_quanzhou.d: Caravans of the village's goods to Quanzhou and back.
Caravans of the village's goods to Xiangyang and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.route_xianyang.d: Caravans of the village's goods to Xianyang and back.
realmlord.workshop.mode.statecraft.desc: Law and government: Politics above all. Students become civil servants, fit for office.
realmlord.workshop.mode.strategy.desc: Sun Tzu and the military classics: Command and Intelligence, 25 days. Students become officers.
realmlord.workshop.mode.tend_horses.desc: The stableman looks after the village's horses and makes nothing else.
realmlord.workshop.mode.warding.desc: Talismans on the gates and walls: Security +4, and raiders and beasts come at the village weaker.
realmlord.workshop.mode.weapon_forms.des: Sabre and spear forms: twice the soldier's experience, Force rises more slowly. They become martial artists.
realmlord.workshop.mode.weapons_practice: Sparring: Force grows twice as fast, a little less experience.
realmlord.workshop.no_learners: Nobody is learning here. Send someone from the list on the right.
realmlord.workshop.no_master_of: No %s at work here: assign one from the Resident window, or nothing is made or taught.
realmlord.workshop.none: No finished building has a master or lessons yet. Build a workshop, the Private School or the Martial Arts Dojo.
realmlord.workshop.open_list.tip: Choose what workshops make, and send people to learn at the school, the dojo or a master's workshop.
